modules.name: Web Panel
modules.description: Lets Raghuvir staff manage all projects, complaints and announcements in one place.

modules.name: Mobile App
modules.description: One app serving Society Managers, Residents and Watchmen, where each user sees only their own project.

requirements.title: Web Panel for managing projects, complaints and announcements
requirements.description: Raghuvir staff must be able to manage all projects, complaints and announcements in one place through the Web Panel.

requirements.title: Single Mobile App for three user types
requirements.description: One Mobile App must serve Society Managers, Residents and Watchmen.

requirements.title: Record every complaint
requirements.description: Every complaint must be recorded, checked, tracked and closed, replacing phone calls, WhatsApp and Excel sheets.

requirements.title: Visibility across all projects for Raghuvir
requirements.description: Raghuvir must have full visibility of complaints across all projects, including which project has the most problems.

requirements.title: Accountability for staff and vendors on delays
requirements.description: The system must make staff and vendors accountable for delays in resolving complaints.

requirements.title: Society Manager approves residents
requirements.description: The Society Manager must be able to approve residents.

requirements.title: Society Manager checks complaints
requirements.description: The Society Manager must check complaints before they move forward.

rules.title: Users see only their own project
rules.description: In the Mobile App, each user sees only their own project.

rules.title: Raghuvir creates the Society Manager
rules.description: The Society Manager account is created by Raghuvir.

rules.title: Complaint closed only with resident agreement
rules.description: A complaint may be closed only when the resident agrees.
